# galaxy_kafka_ingest_source (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kafka_auth` (Attributes) Kafka authentication configuration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--kafka_auth))
- `kafka_brokers` (List of String) Kafka broker addresses
- `name` (String) Name

### Optional

- `cloud_region_id` (String) Cloud region ID where icehouse ingest work is scheduled
- `description` (String) Description
- `password_version` (String) Non-secret value that, when changed, triggers an update that sends the configured `kafka_auth.password`. Use it to rotate the password.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform import identifier.
- `kafka_ingest_source_id` (String) Ingest source ID

<a id="nestedatt--kafka_auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `kafka_auth`

Required:

- `auth_type` (String)

Optional:

- `aws_role_arn` (String) ARN of the AWS IAM role
- `password` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) SASL password
- `scram_type` (String) SCRAM hash algorithm
- `username` (String) SASL username
